description: This file defines the RemoteSiloProber class, which implements the IRemoteSiloProber interface. It provides methods to probe remote silos directly and indirectly within the Orleans runtime membership service, utilizing dependency injection to access system targets.

classes.name: RemoteSiloProber
classes.description: An internal class implementing IRemoteSiloProber, responsible for probing remote silos in the Orleans membership system.

methods.name: Probe
methods.description: Asynchronously probes a remote silo with a specified probe number, supporting cancellation.

methods.name: ProbeIndirectly
methods.description: Asynchronously probes a target silo indirectly via an intermediary, with a specified timeout and support for cancellation.
